name: rekeys_per_h
label: assumption
note: key encapsulation only rekeys per hour inside a session

name: commands_per_s
label: assumption
note: signed or authenticated commands verified per second

name: boots_per_h
label: assumption
note: boots with full image verification per hour of operation

name: image_mb
label: assumption
note: firmware image hashed at boot; upper bound is the cited 1 MB flash of the Crazyflie MCU and the FMUv2 limit

name: ua_per_mhz
label: assumption
note: proxy run current for the platform MCU whose own figure was not retrieved; range spans the cited parts in energy/parts.csv

name: proxy_factor
label: assumption
note: multiplier for the proxy current because the platform MCUs are not the low power parts that were cited (unverified)

name: vdd_v
label: assumption
note: MCU supply voltage; cited VDD ranges run from 1.71 to 3.6 V

name: impl_factor
label: assumption
note: multiplier on published cycles for slower implementations; upper value near the ratio of m4fstack to m4f ML-DSA-44 verify (S2-0036 over S2-0033)

name: crazyflie_cell_v
label: assumption
note: one cell LiPo voltage; not stated in the Crazyflie datasheet (unverified)

name: command_msg_bytes
label: assumption
note: command payload length covered by the MAC; 255 B is the cited MAVLink maximum payload in linksim/params.csv
